messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 33):
"""
Increase in SI (specify rate of increase) and / or b. Discount in Renewal Premium (specify rate of discount allowed) 2.20 Whether system is in place to ensure that the underwriting procedure laid down for the Product is followed? 2.21 Any wellness or preventive elements offered Yes/No (If Yes Give complete details as an annexure) S No Item Particulars (to be filled by the Insurer) Section III: Reinsurance arrangements: 3.1 Retention limit 3.2 Name of the reinsurer(s) 3.3 Terms of reinsurance (type of reinsurance, commissions, etc. 3.4 Any recapture provisions shall be described 3.5 Reinsurance rates provided Section IV: Pricing: 4 Premium Loadings & Discounts (Please provide objective and transparent criteria to offer discounts/rebate/Loadings And complete financial justifications by AA to every item referred hereunder.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}
